People who demand nothing of you

Before I get into the post, I want to say sorry I haven't written here in over a year. I've instead gotten into the habit of writing extremely long posts.

Photo: Sheena Ringo for GuitarBook Magazine (2000)

I've been thinking about what makes some people more enjoyable to be around than others. It might be impolite to talk about this, but there are differences in how people make me feel.

A real section heading

Disclaimer aside, the best answer I've come up with is that the most likable people are those who demand nothing of you, and that is a hard thing to fake for long.
